title: P2 - Signed observation envelope
description: The shape every gcp-observe tool result takes and the only form of evidence rollout-intel accepts. Minted server-side (servers/gcp-observe/envelope.py), verified server-side (servers/rollout-intel/rollout_intel/envelope.py): the HMAC sig covers observation_id, type, scope, observed_at, fresh_until, and content_hash; content_hash is sha256 over the canonical payload. Stale (past fresh_until) or unverifiable envelopes satisfy nothing. Standalone schema: validate your own tool outputs against it if you bridge or reimplement the observe surface.

type.description: Evidence class; the shipped surface emits workload_state, metric_window, log_scan, recommendation_scan.

quality.description: Completeness metadata the policy consumes (e.g. sample_count for min-samples).
